projectDescription: A browser extension that lets you customize your browser's theme color using an interactive color wheel, with support for day/night modes and saved color palettes.
keyFeatures: Interactive color wheel for real-time browser theme customization
Day and night mode toggle for light and dark themes
Save and reuse custom color swatches
Persistent color preferences via browser storage
publicApiSurface: themes - theme object storing day/night color configurations
setTheme(theme, value, mode) - apply a color to the current browser theme
updateColor(theme, value, mode) - update the stored color for a given mode
changeMode(theme, mode) - switch between day and night mode
sendMessage(msg, options) - send a message to the background script
sendMessageToTab(tab, msg, options) - send a message to a specific tab's content script
sendMessageToActiveTab(msg, options) - send a message to the currently active tab
CHANGE_COLOR message type - message type for changing page background color
